name: sendgrid
description: Send email and read stats/contacts with a SendGrid API key. Load for sending transactional email and reading delivery data. Sending email is a real, outward action - confirm intent.

content.inline:
## SendGrid
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.sendgrid.com/v3` with `bearerSecret: "s/SENDGRID_KEY"` (an API key from app.sendgrid.com -> Settings -> API Keys; scope to Mail Send / read-only as needed). Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common calls:
- Send email: `POST /mail/send` body `{personalizations: [{to: [{email}]}], from: {email}, subject, content: [{type: "text/plain", value}]}` (returns 202, empty body)
- Verified senders: `GET /verified_senders`
- Stats: `GET /stats?start_date=YYYY-MM-DD`
- Suppressions (bounces): `GET /suppression/bounces`

Rules:
- Check `status`; 202 = accepted (not a body). Errors are `{errors: [{message, field}]}`. 401 = bad key; 403 = the `from` address is not a verified sender.
- Sending email is an outward action with real recipients - confirm the recipient, subject, and body with the user before calling `/mail/send`. Never send to addresses the user did not supply.
